Stockfish 19 Lite WASM (single-threaded), stockfish.js v19.0.0
Stockfish.js (c) 2026 Chess.com, LLC. Browser port by Nathan Rugg.
Stockfish (c) T. Romstad, M. Costalba, J. Kiiski, G. Linscott and contributors (see AUTHORS).
Lite neural network by Chris Bao (sscg13).

Licensed under GNU GPL version 3. See Copying.txt in this directory.
The unmodified JS and WASM come from the following tagged release:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.0
Upstream engine: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish

Corresponding source is available without charge from this same directory:
  stockfish.js-19.0.0-source.tar.gz
  nn-61e7af4bb97d.nnue
The archive contains the tagged source, browser glue, build scripts and license.
Tagged source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.0
Network source: https://tests.stockfishchess.org/api/nn/nn-61e7af4bb97d.nnue

To build the same flavor, unpack the archive, put nn-61e7af4bb97d.nnue
in its src directory, install the Emscripten toolchain as described in the
tagged build.js and README, then run:
  node build.js --single-threaded --lite --no-split -f
Rookori does not patch the Stockfish release binaries. It exchanges UCI
text with the separate engine worker and uses chess.js for game rules.
